channel.title: This week in Hytale – OrbisHytale
channel.description: What is new in Hytale this week: new items, creatures and animations in the game files, articles and trending servers, updated automatically.

item.title: Hytale ore route: where and when to mine each one
item.description: Which rock each Hytale ore shows up in, which pickaxe breaks each one fastest and which creatures drop ore and ingots.

item.title: Best armor for each stage of Hytale
item.description: The full set for each stage of Hytale, with physical resistance, extra health and the summed cost of all four pieces, from the game files.

item.title: From zero to Mithril: the Hytale progression route
item.description: The order of pickaxes, benches and ingots in Hytale, from level 5 to 50, with recipes and levels taken from the game files.

item.title: Purple sky, Enkindled journals and goblin paintings: the hidden lore of Part 4
item.description: Seven texts and six paintings landed in the 09/24 pre-release without showing up in the official notes. The Enkindled war, magic versus technology, goblins who hate the purple sky and what it may hint at.

item.title: Varyn, the Void and the Echo: the community's theories on Hytale's lore
item.description: Is the Echo a copy of Orbis? Did Varyn cast the curse? Community theories, with what Hypixel and in-game text support or knock down.

item.title: Is Varyn coming back? The Void in Chapter 1
item.description: Shielded crystals, tentacles, corrupted bears and the Breach at 7 minutes: how the Void grows in the files and what it says about Varyn. Theory marked.

item.title: Gaia, Varyn and the Void: what is official in the mythology of Orbis
item.description: The Avatar of Orbis, the villain from another world, the curse of the Void and the Echo: what Hypixel confirmed and what is only interpretation.

item.title: Hytale's factions: who lives in Orbis and who wants you dead
item.description: Kweebecs, Trorks, Ferans, Scaraks, Outlanders, Goblins, the undead, the Void and hidden peoples: culture, types, drops and rivalries.

item.title: Advanced Hytale tips: mechanics the game never explains
item.description: Glider, taming, eternal crops, Update 7 runes, Update 6 Hardcore and hidden shortcuts, each tip backed by the official note that confirms it.

item.title: The bosses and strongest monsters of Orbis
item.description: Who has the most health, what each boss drops and where it lives: dragons, Hedera, Void bears, golems and the first Chapter 1 multi-phase boss.

item.title: After Chapter 1: what Hypixel promised and what the game files are hiding
item.description: Official schedule, art-only goblins and dungeons on hold: what could come to Hytale, with fact, game files and guesswork kept apart.

item.title: What the Goblin Scientist and the hidden art reveal
item.description: Goblin Scientist, Voidtaken Goblin, new trorks, armor sets and a bone glider: what sits in the files with no NPC or item, and what it may hint at.

item.title: Orbis from end to end: zones, biomes and what lives in each one
item.description: Emerald Wilds, Howling Sands, Whisperfrost Frontiers and Devastated Lands: regions, climate, ores, creatures and structures of every zone.

item.title: Hytale by the numbers: the complete timeline
item.description: From the Hypixel server in 2013 to Update 7 in pre-release: every Hytale date, record and update in one list for quick reference.

item.title: 20 Hytale lore details hidden in the game files
item.description: From the Trork name that began as a joke to a Varyn-Mark hidden in a statue: 20 Hytale lore details, each one with its source.

item.title: Hytale and Brazil: Portuguese in the game, community and servers
item.description: Brazilian Portuguese since Update 3, how to help translate, the Portuguese names and how many official list servers serve South America.

item.title: The animals of Orbis: who tames, who rides and where they live
item.description: Favorite food of every tameable animal, the three mounts, milk, wool and eggs, where each animal lives and what Chapter 1 changes for birds and foxes.

item.title: Dungeons and portals: a guide to the Fragments of Orbis
item.description: Ancient Gateway recipe, the five keys, each Fragment timer, the Void Breach, the Forgotten Temple and the Chapter 1 Goblin Breach.

item.title: Hytale for creators: mods, servers and the official tools
item.description: Java plugins, JSON assets, Blockbench, Asset Editor, Node Editor, Trigger Volume and the mod browser: how creating for Hytale works.

item.title: Hytale's game modes: Exploration, Creative, Hardcore and what is still coming
item.description: Exploration, Creative, Hardcore and spectator: what changes in each of Hytale's modes, using the official notes and the game files.

item.title: Hytale's official minigames: from the 2018 promise to 14 party games
item.description: The studio came from Hypixel, yet Hytale has no official minigame. Everything announced, the 14 micro-games shown in July and what is missing.

item.title: Hytale's chapters: what they are and what comes after the goblins
item.description: Chapter 1 is arriving in waves through Update 7. What chapters are, what has been shown and what Hypixel Studios plans for Chapter 2.

item.title: Hytale’s dangerous creatures: health, drops and how to beat them
item.description: The threats of all four zones and the Void night, with each one’s health, drops and spawn hours, plus what the official notes teach about combat.

item.title: Every Hytale bench and what each one crafts
item.description: From the Workbench to the rune Effigy: each station’s recipe, what it crafts, what every tier upgrade costs and the right order to build them.

item.title: First steps in Hytale: from your first stick to your first night
item.description: What to do on day one: gathering, tools, benches, bed, food and the metal ladder, with every recipe checked against the game files.

item.title: Hytale: the full saga, from the 2018 trailer to Update 7
item.description: From the Hypixel server to Update 7: the record trailer, the Riot buyout, the engine switch, the cancellation and the buyback of Hytale, with dates.
